detail.subject: Your registered agent service renews on June 1, 2030
detail.html:
MyFloridaSeriesLLC

Hi Forty,

Your registered agent service for Forty LLC renews on June 1, 2030.

Your renewal notice was delayed. The renewal fee is $99. Automatic charging is on hold; please contact us to resolve the renewal. You may also pay now using this payment link.

To cancel, give notice by May 2, 2030 — in your client portal (the Registered agent service card) or by email to support@myfloridaseriesllc.com. Florida law requires your LLC to have a registered agent at all times, so you must also designate a successor agent with the Division of Corporations and send us proof; the Terms of Service explain both steps.

Questions? Just reply to this email.

MyFloridaSeriesLLC — support@myfloridaseriesllc.com
